checks.text: A Package of unsent items is Open
In Progress as soon as anything is submitted
Mohammed closes the items at A, B, C and D
With a Code C waiting for its Revision the Package is still In Progress
A Revision of the Code C item is created
The Revision joins the Package by itself and the Package stays In Progress
Done: every latest submittal has closed at A, B or D
A replacement for the Code D item joins and puts the Package back In Progress
The word is In Progress or Done, never Closed
